prompts.grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single square ground tile texture for the dark gothic fantasy tactical browser game Duelyant. Primary request: top-down view of compact brown earth with sparse muted olive grass, fine roots and tiny stones. Entire square covered by ground, no border, no UI, no writing, no objects, no horizon. Painterly sculptural realistic material texture, subtle old engraved grain, desaturated earthy browns and moss olive, soft light from upper left, enough midtone detail to read at 50px but a quiet center for action icons. Flat overhead camera, tileable-looking edges, not isometric. 1024x1024. Original game texture, no neon, no shiny 3D.
prompts.rock: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single square blocked terrain tile for the dark gothic fantasy tactical browser game Duelyant. Primary request: overhead view of one large impassable rugged granite boulder, fractured uneven grey rock filling 85 percent of the square, small rim of brown earth and sparse muted olive grass. Strong recognizable rock silhouette, chunky angular planes, weathered cracks with tiny moss traces. Painterly sculptural realistic material, fine engraving-like grain, desaturated charcoal graphite stone, light from upper left, deep contact shadow. Direct top-down view, square composition, no perspective horizon, no border, no text, no UI, no characters. 1024x1024. Readable as a blocked rock tile at 50px, not an icon floating on black.
prompts.kick: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square combat action icon for the dark gothic fantasy game Duelyant, matching its sculptural, grainy painted inventory illustrations. Primary request: a single anatomically believable bare human foot and lower shin executing a forceful forward kick, seen in three-quarter side view, toes toward upper right, heel and sole clearly readable. Leg fades into shadow near lower left; no full character, no clothing, no shoe, no gender cues, no blood or wounds, no extra limbs. Strong compact diagonal silhouette, warm weathered skin, light from above/front-left, deep shadows, fine old oil and engraved surface texture. Almost black charcoal background #101410. Foot entirely in frame, 8 percent empty margin, no words, no frame, no motion text, no neon or glossy 3D. 1024x1024, must read at 40px.
prompts.sword: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single square inventory illustration for the dark gothic fantasy browser game Duelyant. Primary request: one original ephemeral one-handed sword, whole sword diagonally from grip lower left to point upper right. Weathered dark iron hilt with short leather-wrapped one-hand grip; blade is pale translucent smoky silver-green spectral steel, a clear sharp sword silhouette with a few gaps dissolving into restrained mist, suggesting it can pass through stone. Desaturated charcoal, old iron, ivory, a small muted spectral green accent. Almost-black #101410 background, 8 percent margins, no cropped tip, no holder, no text, no ornate frame, no UI, no neon, no plastic 3D. 1024x1024 readable at 40-56px.
